note: Small user-maintained campground on the upper Red Deer River, 22 km southwest of Sundre on the paved Coalcamp Road, run by the Friends of the Eastern Slopes Association. Individual sites are in the trees between the road and the river, with a group site across the road. Pack out all garbage; bring toilet paper and hand sanitizer. No firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Sep 16, 2026) and FOESA's page: free (membership encouraged), 12 unserviced first-come sites, vault toilets, no water, season Year-round (derived Apr 20 - Sep 15 -> year_round). Phone 403-304-0456 suggested. Riverbank wording is a waterfront lead; pin optional move across the road.
